title: Astrid and the Horizon
author: Edmund Sterling
blurb: Cyrus Amberdale, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
